alternate_names: Noida Bengali Cultural Association Kali Mandir

history.summary: The Kalibari of Noida's Bengali community at E 5 C, Sector 26, run by the Noida Bengali Cultural Association. It has organised community Durga Puja and Kali Puja every year since the 1980s and serves as a Bengali cultural centre; an adjoining dharamshala offers accommodation for visitors. NOT to be confused with the separate Greater Noida Kalibari at Knowledge Park (a different organisation). Opening hours conflict: one guide says the temple stays open through the day with evening aarti at 7:30 PM; a listing source says 6:30 AM-1:00 PM with gates open until 10:00 PM (verify).

name: Kali Bari Temple Noida
town_description: Noida (New Okhla Industrial Development Authority) is a planned city in Gautam Buddha Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, on the eastern edge of the National Capital Region. Developed from the late 1970s as an industrial township across the Yamuna from Delhi, it is now a major hub for IT, media, and manufacturing, with wide avenues, metro connectivity, and a large Bengali, south Indian, and pan-Indian migrant population that sustains many community temples.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (~28 km)
travel.railway: Noida has no mainline station; nearest: New Delhi / Hazrat Nizamuddin
travel.road: E 5 C, Sector 26; nearest metro: Noida Botanical Garden / Sector 16 / Sector 18 (Blue Line), then auto-rickshaw

visitor_information.best_time: September to November, for Durga Puja and Kali Puja
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open through the day; evening aarti at 7:30 PM (one source lists 6:30 AM-1:00 PM and open until 10:00 PM; verify)
